attribution.title: LearnX Curated 3-Problem-per-Module DSA Sheet
attribution.description: 57 canonical problems across 19 modules with full descriptions, test cases, and starter code.

roadmap.name: Striver's A2Z DSA Sheet (Curated)
roadmap.description: The essential 19-section DSA curriculum curated to 3 core problems per module for high-velocity mastery.

topics.name: Beginner Problems
topics.description: Language basics, loops, math foundations, and pattern printing logic.

subtopics.name: Beginner Problems Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Beginner Problems

problems.title: Pattern 1
problems.summary: Print an N x N square star pattern.
problems.description:
Given an integer N, print an N x N grid of asterisks (*).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines each containing N asterisks without spaces.

problems.title: Reverse a Number
problems.summary: Reverse the digits of a given integer.
problems.description:
Given an integer N, reverse its digits. If N is negative, preserve the minus sign.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
The integer with reversed digits.

problems.title: Check Palindrome Number
problems.summary: Check whether an integer reads the same forwards and backwards.
problems.description:
Given an integer N, return true if N is a palindrome integer, or false otherwise.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
true or false

topics.name: Sorting
topics.description: Comparison-based sorting routines, in-place partitions, and merge routines.

problems.title: Selection Sort
problems.summary: Sort an array using the selection sort algorithm.
problems.description:
Given an array of N integers, sort the array in non-decreasing order using Selection Sort.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
The sorted array space-separated.

problems.title: Bubble Sort
problems.summary: Sort an array using the bubble sort algorithm.
problems.description:
Given an array of N integers, sort the array in non-decreasing order using Bubble Sort.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
The sorted array space-separated.

problems.title: Merge Sort
problems.summary: Sort an array using the divide-and-conquer merge sort algorithm.
problems.description:
Given an array of N integers, sort the array in ascending order using Merge Sort.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated integers

Output Format:
The sorted array space-separated.

topics.name: Arrays
topics.description: Contiguous linear storage, two-pointer logic, and subsegment optimizations.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.summary: Find two numbers in array that add up to target and return 0-based indices.
problems.description:
Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated integers
Line 3: target

Output Format:
Two space-separated indices in ascending order.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.summary: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum (Kadane’s algorithm).
problems.description:
Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated integers

Output Format:
A single integer representing the maximum subarray sum.

problems.title: Move Zeroes to End
problems.summary: Move all zeros in array to the end while maintaining relative order of non-zero elements.
problems.description:
Given an integer array nums, move all 0's to the end of it while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements in-place.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated integers

Output Format:
The modified array space-separated.

topics.name: Hashing
topics.description: Hash maps, frequency tables, and constant-time key lookups.

problems.title: Count Frequency of Elements
problems.summary: Count frequency of each distinct element.
problems.description:
Count frequency of each element in the array. Output each pair as element:frequency in ascending order of element.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
Space-separated element:count pairs.

problems.title: Highest and Lowest Frequency
problems.summary: Find the highest and lowest frequency elements.
problems.description:
Given an array of N integers, find the element with highest frequency and element with lowest frequency.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
Two integers: highest_freq_element lowest_freq_element.

problems.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
problems.summary: Find the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence.
problems.description:
Given an unsorted array of integers, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence in O(N) time.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated integers

Output Format:
A single integer length.

topics.name: Binary Search
topics.description: Logarithmic search boundaries, monotonic predicates, and rotated arrays.

subtopics.name: Binary Search Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Binary Search

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.summary: Search for a target value in a sorted array in O(log N).
problems.description:
Given an array of integers nums which is sorted in ascending order, and an integer target, return the 0-based index of target, or -1 if not found.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N sorted integers
Line 3: target

Output Format:
Index of target, or -1.

problems.title: Search Insert Position
problems.summary: Find the index where target would be inserted in sorted order.
problems.description:
Given a sorted array of distinct integers and a target value, return the index if the target is found. If not, return the index where it would be if it were inserted in order.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N sorted integers
Line 3: target

Output Format:
Insert index.

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.summary: Find the minimum element in a rotated sorted array in O(log N).
problems.description:
Given the sorted rotated array nums of unique elements, return the minimum element of this array.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
The minimum element.

topics.name: Recursion
topics.description: Call stacks, recurrence relations, base conditions, and backtracking.

problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.summary: Compute the N-th Fibonacci number.
problems.description:
The Fibonacci numbers are defined by F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(N)=F(N-1)+F(N-2). Given N, calculate F(N).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
F(N).

problems.title: Power of Two
problems.summary: Determine if an integer is a power of two.
problems.description:
Given an integer N, return true if it is a power of two, or false otherwise.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
true or false.

problems.title: Subsets
problems.summary: Calculate the total count of power set subsets.
problems.description:
Given an array of unique integers, return the total count of subsets (the power set) which is 2^N.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
Total count of subsets.

topics.name: Linked-List
topics.description: Node pointers, traversal, in-place pointer manipulation, and cycle detection.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.summary: Reverse a singly linked list.
problems.description:
Given a singly linked list represented as an array of values, reverse the nodes and output space-separated values.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N values

Output Format:
Reversed values space-separated.

problems.title: Middle of the Linked List
problems.summary: Find the middle node of a singly linked list.
problems.description:
Given a non-empty, singly linked list, return the value of the middle node. If there are two middle nodes, return the second middle node.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N values

Output Format:
Value of the middle node.

problems.title: Detect Cycle in Linked List
problems.summary: Detect if a linked list contains a cycle.
problems.description:
Given N nodes and the 0-based position where the tail connects back (-1 if no cycle), return true if there is a cycle, else false.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N node values
Line 3: pos index (-1 for none)

Output Format:
true or false.

topics.name: Bit Manipulation
topics.description: Bitwise AND, OR, XOR, shifts, and masks.

subtopics.name: Bit Manipulation Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Bit Manipulation

problems.title: Check if K-th Bit is Set
problems.summary: Check whether the K-th bit of a number is set.
problems.description:
Given two integers N and K (0-indexed from right), return true if the K-th bit is 1, else false.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers N and K.

Output Format:
true or false.

problems.title: Single Number
problems.summary: Find the element that appears once in array of duplicates.
problems.description:
Given a non-empty array of integers nums, every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated integers

Output Format:
The unique element.

problems.title: Count Set Bits
problems.summary: Count number of 1-bits in the binary representation of an integer.
problems.description:
Given an integer N, return the number of set bits (1s) in its binary representation.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Number of set bits.

topics.name: Greedy Algorithms
topics.description: Locally optimal choices, interval scheduling, and activity selection.

subtopics.name: Greedy Algorithms Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Greedy Algorithms

problems.title: Assign Cookies
problems.summary: Maximize number of content children with cookie sizes.
problems.description:
Given children greed factors g and cookie sizes s, maximize the number of content children.

Input Format:
Line 1: Number of children
Line 2: Children greed factors
Line 3: Number of cookies
Line 4: Cookie sizes

Output Format:
Maximum number of content children.

problems.title: Lemonade Change
problems.summary: Check if you can provide correct change to every customer.
problems.description:
Each customer pays with $5, $10, or $20. Return true if you can provide correct change to every customer, false otherwise.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N customer bill denominations

Output Format:
true or false.

problems.title: Jump Game
problems.summary: Determine if you can reach the last index starting at index 0.
problems.description:
You are given an integer array nums where each element represents your maximum jump length at that position. Return true if you can reach the last index, or false otherwise.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N jump lengths

Output Format:
true or false.

topics.name: Sliding Window / 2 Pointer
topics.description: Dynamic window resizing, subarray sums, and string matching.

subtopics.name: Sliding Window / 2 Pointer Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Sliding Window / 2 Pointer

problems.title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K
problems.summary: Find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of size K.
problems.description:
Given an array of integers and a number K, find the maximum sum of a subarray of size K.

Input Format:
Line 1: N and K
Line 2: N space-separated integers

Output Format:
Maximum sum.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.summary: Find the length of the longest substring with unique characters.
problems.description:
Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

Input Format:
A single string s.

Output Format:
Length of longest unique substring.

problems.title: Max Consecutive Ones
problems.summary: Find the maximum number of consecutive 1s in a binary array.
problems.description:
Given a binary array nums, return the maximum number of consecutive 1's in the array.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N binary digits (0 or 1)

Output Format:
Max count of consecutive 1s.

topics.name: Stack / Queues
topics.description: LIFO and FIFO data structures, monotonic stacks, and parentheses matching.

subtopics.name: Stack / Queues Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Stack / Queues

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.summary: Check if bracket pairs are correctly closed and nested.
problems.description:
Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.

Input Format:
A single string s.

Output Format:
true or false.

problems.title: Next Greater Element
problems.summary: Find next greater element for each array item.
problems.description:
Given an array of N integers, find the Next Greater Element for every element in order. If none exists, output -1.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
Space-separated next greater elements.

problems.title: Min Stack
problems.summary: Design a stack that retrieves the minimum element in O(1).
problems.description:
Execute stack commands: push X, pop, top, getMin.

Input Format:
Line 1: Total operations
Next lines: command arguments

Output Format:
Result of queries printed line-by-line.

topics.name: Binary Trees
topics.description: Hierarchical data, DFS/BFS tree traversals, and height/diameter properties.

subtopics.name: Binary Trees Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Binary Trees

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.summary: Find the maximum depth (height) of a binary tree.
problems.description:
Given level-order traversal of a binary tree (-1 represents null node), compute the maximum depth.

Input Format:
Space-separated level-order integers.

Output Format:
Max depth integer.

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.summary: Invert a binary tree (mirror image).
problems.description:
Given a binary tree level-order, invert the tree and return level-order values.

Input Format:
Space-separated level-order integers.

Output Format:
Inverted tree level-order integers.

problems.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.summary: Compute the longest path between any two nodes in a tree.
problems.description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return the length of the diameter of the tree.

Input Format:
Level-order node values.

Output Format:
Diameter length.

topics.name: Binary Search Trees
topics.description: Ordered binary trees, range queries, and lowest common ancestors.

subtopics.name: Binary Search Trees Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Binary Search Trees

problems.title: Search in a Binary Search Tree
problems.summary: Search for a target value in a Binary Search Tree.
problems.description:
Given the root node of a BST and an integer val, return true if val exists in the BST, else false.

Input Format:
Line 1: Level-order BST values
Line 2: Target value

Output Format:
true or false.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.summary: Determine if a binary tree is a valid BST.
problems.description:
Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST).

Input Format:
Level-order tree values.

Output Format:
true or false.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a BST
problems.summary: Find the lowest common ancestor (LCA) node of two given nodes.
problems.description:
Given a binary search tree (BST), find the lowest common ancestor (LCA) node of two given nodes.

Input Format:
Line 1: Level-order BST
Line 2: Value of node p and node q

Output Format:
Value of the LCA node.

topics.name: Heaps
topics.description: Priority queues, min/max heap properties, and top-K problems.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problems.summary: Find the Kth largest element in an unsorted array.
problems.description:
Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the kth largest element in the array.

Input Format:
Line 1: N and K
Line 2: N space-separated integers

Output Format:
The kth largest element.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.summary: Find the K most frequent elements in an array.
problems.description:
Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements in descending order of frequency.

Input Format:
Line 1: N and K
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
Space-separated top K elements.

problems.title: Sort Characters By Frequency
problems.summary: Sort characters in string by descending frequency.
problems.description:
Given a string s, sort it in decreasing order based on the frequency of the characters.

Input Format:
A single string s.

Output Format:
The sorted string.

topics.name: Graphs
topics.description: Adjacency lists, BFS/DFS traversals, connected components, and topological sorts.

problems.title: Breadth First Search
problems.summary: Perform BFS traversal on a graph starting at vertex 0.
problems.description:
Given V vertices and E undirected edges, return the BFS traversal sequence starting from vertex 0.

Input Format:
Line 1: V and E
Next E lines: u v

Output Format:
Space-separated traversal order.

problems.title: Depth First Search
problems.summary: Perform DFS traversal on a graph starting at vertex 0.
problems.description:
Given V vertices and E undirected edges, return the DFS traversal sequence starting from vertex 0.

Input Format:
Line 1: V and E
Next E lines: u v

Output Format:
Space-separated traversal order.

problems.title: Number of Provinces
problems.summary: Count connected components in an adjacency matrix.
problems.description:
There are N cities. An N x N matrix isConnected is given. Return total number of provinces (connected components).

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Next N lines: N binary values (0 or 1)

Output Format:
Total provinces count.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming
topics.description: Overlapping subproblems, optimal substructure, memoization, and tabulation.

subtopics.name: Dynamic Programming Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Dynamic Programming

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.summary: Calculate distinct ways to reach top taking 1 or 2 steps.
problems.description:
You are climbing a staircase. It takes N steps to reach the top. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. How many distinct ways can you climb to the top?

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Number of ways.

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.summary: Find the fewest number of coins needed to make up amount.
problems.description:
You are given an integer array coins and an integer amount. Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount, or -1 if impossible.

Input Format:
Line 1: N and amount
Line 2: N coin denominations

Output Format:
Minimum coin count, or -1.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.summary: Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
problems.description:
Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N integers

Output Format:
Length of LIS.

topics.name: Tries
topics.description: Prefix trees, string lookups, and auto-complete indexing.

problems.title: Implement Trie
problems.summary: Implement insert, search, and startsWith operations on a prefix tree.
problems.description:
Process Trie operations: insert WORD, search WORD, startsWith PREFIX. Output true or false for search/startsWith queries.

Input Format:
Line 1: Total operations
Next lines: operation word

Output Format:
Query results line-by-line.

problems.title: Longest Word with All Prefixes
problems.summary: Find the longest word where every prefix is present.
problems.description:
Given an array of strings, return the longest string such that every prefix of it is also in the array.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Next N lines: strings

Output Format:
The longest word.

problems.title: Count Distinct Substrings
problems.summary: Count total number of distinct substrings.
problems.description:
Given a string s, return the total number of distinct non-empty substrings.

Input Format:
A single string s.

Output Format:
Distinct substring count.

topics.name: Strings (Advanced Algo)
topics.description: String matching, rolling hashes, and character manipulation.

subtopics.name: Strings (Advanced Algo) Core
subtopics.description: Core curated problems for Strings (Advanced Algo)

problems.title: Longest Common Prefix
problems.summary: Find the longest common prefix amongst an array of strings.
problems.description:
Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. If none, return empty string.

Input Format:
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated strings

Output Format:
Longest common prefix.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.summary: Determine if two strings are anagrams of each other.
problems.description:
Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.

Input Format:
Line 1: String s
Line 2: String t

Output Format:
true or false.

problems.title: String to Integer (atoi)
problems.summary: Convert a string to a 32-bit signed integer.
problems.description:
Implement the myAtoi(string s) function, which converts a string to a 32-bit signed integer.

Input Format:
A single line string.

Output Format:
The converted 32-bit integer.

topics.name: Maths
topics.description: Primes, modular arithmetic, Euclidean GCD, and combinatorics.

problems.title: Count Primes
problems.summary: Count the number of prime numbers strictly less than N.
problems.description:
Given an integer N, return the number of prime numbers that are strictly less than N using Sieve of Eratosthenes.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Prime count.

problems.title: Greatest Common Divisor
problems.summary: Calculate the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two numbers.
problems.description:
Given two non-zero positive integers A and B, find their Greatest Common Divisor using the Euclidean algorithm.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers A and B.

Output Format:
The GCD.

problems.title: Modular Exponentiation
problems.summary: Compute (Base^Exp) % Mod in O(log Exp).
problems.description:
Given three integers Base, Exp, and Mod, compute (Base ^ Exp) % Mod.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers: Base Exp Mod

Output Format:
Resulting modulo integer.
